**About Team & About Role:**

  

As a Software Engineer (SE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org.

You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup & management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains.

We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and harden identity and access flows — OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations — that sit in front of mission-critical systems.
* Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions.
* Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought.
* Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic.
* Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly.

* Strong hands-on programming skills in **Golang**.
* Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols: **OIDC/OAuth 2.0** and **SAML 2.0** — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes.

* Applied cryptography/PKI experience: **X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS**.
* Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work.
* Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency.
* Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts.
* Simple, effective written and verbal communication.

* Directory internals (schema, bind operations).
* HTTP internals and reverse proxying (TLS, header injection).

Job Description – **Software Engineer**

**Role:** Application Security & Vulnerability Management  
**Job Family:** Software Engineering  
**Primary Focus:** Cybersecurity Remediation  
**Essential Technology:** .NET Core / C#  
**Preferred Technologies:** Java and Angular  
**Experience:** Bangalore  
**Job Type:** Full-Time

Role Overview

We are looking for a Software Engineer with strong hands-on experience in **C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET Core** to support cybersecurity vulnerability identification, assessment, prioritization, and remediation across enterprise applications and services.

The role will primarily focus on resolving application security vulnerabilities, Dependabot alerts, outdated or vulnerable dependencies, and secure coding issues.

The ideal candidate should have a strong software development background combined with practical application security and vulnerability remediation experience. The individual will collaborate with engineering, DevOps, architecture, and cybersecurity teams to strengthen application security, improve vulnerability management processes, and establish repeatable remediation workflows.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Vulnerability Analysis & Remediation**

* Analyze, investigate, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities identified through Dependabot and other security scanning tools.
* Identify and resolve security findings across application code, third-party libraries, frameworks, APIs, container images, and supporting components.
* Assess vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, business exposure, and application criticality.
* Upgrade vulnerable or unsupported packages, libraries, and frameworks while minimizing compatibility issues and regression risks.
* Validate remediation through testing, security rescanning, and appropriate evidence documentation.

**2. Secure Software Engineering**

* Design, develop, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise applications and backend services using C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET Core.
* Implement secure coding practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Identify and remediate common application security vulnerabilities, particularly OWASP Top 10 risks.
* Participate in code reviews, solution reviews, security discussions, and root cause analysis.
* Develop automated tests and regression test coverage for security fixes.

**3. DevSecOps & Dependency Management**

* Integrate and improve security checks within CI/CD pipelines and source code repository workflows.
* Monitor application dependency health and ensure timely remediation of critical and high-severity vulnerabilities.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to improve automated security scanning, alert routing, reporting, and policy enforcement.
* Support the establishment of vulnerability remediation SLAs, exception handling, and escalation processes.
* Improve dependency management practices and reduce recurring security findings.

**4. Security Maturity & Process Improvement**

* Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of vulnerability management processes and maturity models.
* Establish repeatable workflows covering vulnerability intake, triage, ownership, remediation, validation, exception management, and closure.
* Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to strengthen engineering ownership and reduce recurring vulnerabilities.
* Support the development of security metrics, dashboards, and maturity assessments.
* Promote secure engineering practices across development teams.

**5. Documentation & Security Artifact Generation**

* Create and maintain vulnerability remediation playbooks, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and workflow documentation.
* Prepare risk assessment templates, remediation plans, validation evidence, exception records, and audit-ready documentation.
* Document lessons learned, recurring root causes, secure coding guidelines, and reusable remediation approaches.
* Communicate remediation progress, technical risks, dependencies, and decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Essential Skills & Experience

**.NET Development**

* Strong hands-on software development experience with C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET Core.
* Experience developing and maintaining REST APIs, backend services, and enterprise applications.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex application, dependency, framework, build, and runtime compatibility issues.

**Application Security & Vulnerability Management**

* Proven experience identifying, analyzing, and remediating application security vulnerabilities.
* Hands-on experience with Dependabot or equivalent Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tools.
* Strong understanding of secure coding practices and OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
* Knowledge of CVE concepts and CVSS-based vulnerability assessment and prioritization.

* Ability to work closely with cybersecurity, DevOps, architecture, and quality engineering teams.

Design, develop, and debug the embedded firmware that controls and communicates with our autonomous material movement robots. Real ownership of production-grade firmware on robots deployed in the field.

* Debug with ST-LINK/SWD, JTAG, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and CAN analyzers, driving field issues to root cause
* Write Python tools for firmware testing, log analysis, CAN/serial parsing, and test automation
* Design modular, non-blocking, interrupt-driven firmware with state machines and fault handling
* Maintain versioned firmware releases in Git and document firmware design and release notes

### Requirements

* B.E./B.Tech in ECE, EEE, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related field
* 1 to 2 years of hands-on embedded firmware development

* Proficiency in Python for scripting, tooling, and test automation
* Comfortable with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and CAN/serial analyzers
* Proficiency with Git (branches, merges, tags, releases)
